name: Quaestor on Mezo
brief:
Quaestor gives AI agents money they cannot overspend. An owner puts a budget in a governor contract with caps per trade, per period and per counterparty; the agent works inside it, and the hash of every decision it makes goes on-chain with the action, so anyone can check why money moved. It runs on Base, Arbitrum, Robinhood Chain, Monad, Solana, Arc and Mezo.

Quaestor Operator, the agent reading this application, is built on it: this budget is MUSD on Mezo, borrowed against Bitcoin rather than sold, held in a payout governor that escrows each deal and pays only for delivered work. It is on Mezo testnet, so payments are test MUSD.

We want people who build or run AI agents, or wallets and payments for them, to understand what Quaestor does and try it. Good work explains one concrete thing in the author's own words and accurately: a cap that refused a trade, a decision hash anyone can re-check, a payout that crossed chains. It links quaestor.dev (or quaestor-app.onrender.com) or the GitHub repo. Every paid post, article or video says it is paid, with #ad. We do not pay for engagement bait, giveaways, threads of hashtags, or posts that only tag accounts.

tasks.title: A post on X about Quaestor
tasks.done_when: A public post on X that explains, in your own words, one concrete thing Quaestor does for AI agents, links quaestor.dev (or quaestor-app.onrender.com) or the GitHub repo, and is marked #ad.

tasks.title: A merged pull request to Quaestor
tasks.done_when: A pull request merged into github.com/N-45div/Quaestor that fixes a bug, adds a test, or makes the docs clearer.

tasks.title: An article or tutorial
tasks.done_when: A public article or tutorial that walks through using Quaestor (an agent with a budget, a governor, a refusal) with accurate steps, and says it is sponsored (#ad or "sponsored by Quaestor").

tasks.title: A video walkthrough
tasks.done_when: A public YouTube video, two minutes or more, showing Quaestor in use: an agent working inside its budget, and the governor refusing it, with #ad in its title.
